name: Zep Context MCP Server
summary: Hosted MCP server that connects an end user's MCP client (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Codex...) to their own agent memory in Zep, gated by your identity provider.
description: One endpoint for all clients and projects on Zep managed cloud (BYOC uses /mcp on its own host). Users sign in via Google Workspace or, on Enterprise, a custom OIDC IdP. Uses per-account MCP seats that vary by plan. Distinct from Zep's public Documentation MCP server. Usually installed via the Zep Context plugin (MCP connection plus a skill).
